thread.title: DRAIN event-driven register and touch-map runtime ingestion
thread.purpose: Prepare the DRAIN design, runtime artefacts, corrections, evidence and current state for governed GRK ingestion into the Pen provider-neutral thread runtime.
thread.source_completeness: Complete for the visible current thread and six uploaded attachments; no hidden transcript or external runtime logs were available to the submitter.

classification.rationale: Canonical artefacts exist, but authenticated S3/Pen submission, independent remote readback, Bridge ACK, database persistence and production telemetry remain unproven.

completed_work.result: Defines event contract, Supabase event table, routing rules and acceptance criteria.
Local DRAIN session controller UI with buckets, validators, evidence and receipt fields, export and close gate.
Dependency-light extraction, touch-map, table-candidate, metrics and receipt generator.
Design specification for drain_runs, sources, objects, candidates, touch maps, changes, metrics and receipts.
Strategic narrative framing DRAIN as archaeology of attention and institutional memory.
Prior execution summary identifying missing runtime persistence and telemetry; exact commit IDs were not included in the uploaded file.

thread_decisions: DRAIN is an event-driven intake fabric, not merely a bookmark UI.
OAuth/DCR analysis was explicitly removed from scope.
No passive review sink is acceptable; actionable items must emit events and route onward.
Supabase is optional and must not block canonical thread ingestion.
Local durable spool or S3 is the primary provider-neutral submission path.
A GitHub commit proves artefact existence but not runtime execution.
known_external_claims_not_independently_: GitHub issues #69, #70 and #71 are referenced by the register pack.
Repository TML-4PM/proof_pot and prior GitHub MCP artefact creation are described in the uploaded receipt document.
Issue #74 and bridge_id zdgnab3py0 appear in the HTML seed state.
No exact historical commit SHA, PR number, deployed URL or production readback was supplied in the thread evidence.

commitments: Persist event and touch-map outputs in a runtime store.
Patch all UI actions to emit canonical events.
Route registered and execution-requested events to Pen/Dev and capture ACK receipts.
Expose live queue and REAL/PARTIAL/BLOCKED telemetry.
failures_and_blockers: No authenticated remote Pen ACK yet.
No Bridge ACK or runtime service readback.
No database migration execution or live row readback.
open_state.exact_next_executable_action: Run this deterministic envelope through tools/thread_runtime_submit.py with the authenticated S3 backend and verify the object through independent GetObject readback.

systems_changed: Pen repository branch now contains the canonical envelope and submission operator changes.

authority_boundaries: Do not assert remote GitHub, S3, database or Bridge state without readback.
Personal and business context is included only where relevant to DRAIN and WorkFamilyAI assessment.
dependencies: authenticated Pen runtime for downstream ACK
